target.summary: Fall at home on Sep 25, 2026 with a skin tear to the left forearm; PT recommends a walker and home safety evaluation.

planted.text: Chart correction per Dr. Abernathy, attending physician: the entry describing the fall on Sep 25, 2026 was documented on the wrong participant and does not apply to Jerónimo. Disregard it for care planning; no action needed.

headline: New evening confusion since about mid-October, including a stove left on, has no documented work-up result, and the caregiver reported exhaustion and asked for respite on 2026-11-22.

items.statement: On 2026-11-02 the grandson Robert reported about two weeks of increased evening confusion, with the stove left on once. Jerónimo was oriented to person and place but not date, and had no fever. The nurse planned a urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit that week.
items.verifier_note: All details match the 2026-11-02 nursing note: two weeks of evening confusion, stove left on once, oriented to person and place but not date, no fever, and the planned urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit that week.

items.statement: On 2026-11-22 Robert, the primary caregiver, reported exhaustion and poor sleep and worry about managing evenings alone. He requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed.
items.verifier_note: The 2026-11-22 social work note matches every detail: Robert as primary caregiver, exhaustion, poor sleep, worry about evenings alone, the respite request, and discussion of respite options and a support group.

items.statement: The evidence has no urinalysis result, medication review outcome or PCP visit for the confusion after 2026-11-02. The record shows no encounters in the period, and the 2026-11-13 nursing check says only 'no new concerns'.
items.verifier_note: The encounters record is empty, and the 2026-11-13 note says 'No new concerns'. The cited sources contain no urinalysis result, medication review outcome or PCP visit after 11-02.

items.statement: The PT evaluation on 2026-09-29 found slow, unsteady gait with intermittent cane use and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds. It recommended a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation, bathroom grab bars, and PT twice weekly. The note cites a fall on 2026-09-25, but a 2026-09-27 chart correction says that fall entry was documented on the wrong participant and should be disregarded. It is unclear whether the PT findings and referral still apply.
items.verifier_note: The PT findings and recommendations match the evaluation note. The correction note is also described accurately. However, 'PT twice weekly' is accurate but the chronology is off: the correction dated 2026-09-27 precedes the 2026-09-29 PT evaluation, so the statement's framing is mostly fine. The remaining issue is that the draft calls the evaluation's applicability 'unclear', which is an inference not stated in the sources.

items.statement: No influenza vaccine is recorded for this season, which began 2026-08-01. The last recorded dose was on 2026-06-30.
items.verifier_note: The record shows no flu vaccine this season (season start 2026-08-01). However, the last dose is dated 2026-06-30, which is before the season start. The statement is accurate on the date, but calling the absence of a dose 'for this season' is fine. Nothing in the record is contradicted, but the claim that the 06-30 dose is the last is supported only within the two-year window.

questions: Were the urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit planned on 2026-11-02 completed, and what were the results?
